Every product has its own four designs (tote bags: four undyed and four black, eight in all) (one cat, one dog, many cats, many dogs). folk.style: Naive folk-art painting in gouache with a hand-printed linocut feel: bold flat shapes with visible brush and paper texture, fine hand-drawn patterns inside the fur (dots, dashes, stripes, tiny leaves), big round expressive eyes, tall simple animal shapes with long whiskers. Rich warm autumn palette: pumpkin orange, mustard yellow, brick red, cream, teal and deep charcoal.

birthday.name: Birthday
birthday.note: 15 Oct 2026 (John): eight postcards and eight greeting cards, four for girls and four for boys each (dog and child, cat and child, cats and child, dogs and child), no words. Style = John's own written brief. No gift-set picture. Test 1 (15 Oct 2026): John asked for 20% more curve and thicker, freehand lines (the first lines looked ruler-straight and thin); dogs looked like foxes, the girl's eyes were not round, the boy read as a girl. Test 2: lines and curves OK to check; the boy-and-cat card got an extra dog, so the style now says only the animals named in the subject appear. 15 Oct 2026 (John, after launch): art style and technique is now "Scandinavian mid-century folk art style. Gouache painting texture, dry-brush acrylic strokes, and visible colored pencil grain." (the word 'flat' is gone); the same words are the 'Art style' row on the birthday product pages.
birthday.mood: Bright, happy birthday mood: small wrapped presents, paper bunting and a few paper confetti pieces; no Halloween or Christmas items, no snow.

postcard.style: A flat 2D naive folk art children's book illustration in a mid-century Scandinavian style. Only the child and the animals named in the subject appear in the picture, no other cats or dogs. All the characters (cats are tall and angular) share long vertical silhouettes, sharp pointed geometric features, wide perfectly round wide-open eyes with dark pupils, and black brush-ink whiskers/details. Every child has the same wide perfectly round wide-open eyes with dark pupils. Dogs are clearly friendly pet dogs, never foxes or wolves: floppy or folded ears, a medium muzzle, a dark dog nose, a collar, and no whiskers. A boy has short hair cut above the ears and wears a patterned shirt and trousers. Theme: a whimsical birthday celebration. The characters are wearing folk-patterned birthday party hats, surrounded by folk-art style wrapped presents with simple geometric ribbons, stylized wooden party banners/bunting overhead (plain patterned flags, no letters), and a flat-painted birthday cake decorated with simple folk candles. Art style and technique: Scandinavian mid-century folk art style. Gouache painting texture, dry-brush acrylic strokes, and visible colored pencil grain. Abstract, geometric, minimalist shapes with sharp silhouettes, but about 20% more curved than strict geometry: long lines bend gently, corners are slightly softened, and nothing looks drawn with a ruler. Every line is drawn freehand with a brush: bold, clearly thick and a little uneven in width, never thin or hairline. Solid vibrant block colors (burnt orange, mustard yellow, deep teal, matte black) with subtle paper-like texture overlay. Strictly avoid: soft vector clipart, 3D shading, smooth gradient lighting, rounded plush shapes, digital softness, glossy plastic textures, ruler-straight lines, or thin hairline strokes.
postcard.layout: A full birthday scene, full of life, that fills the whole picture edge to edge on {background}, with intricate flat Nordic botanical patterns, party elements, and line-drawn flora surrounding the characters; the floor or the grass runs off the bottom and both sides. This is a full-bleed print file: the colour reaches all four edges, with no paper margin and no cream or white strip, line, border or frame along any edge. Only the flat picture itself: do not draw the postcard, no stack of cards, no product, no shadow.

One style for both products (whimsical Nordic folk art); no gift-set picture. Cards changed the same day: John loved the Lantern Cat postcard and disliked the first Holly Dog card (a dog in a symmetrical ornament frame on plain cream, with a cat-like face), so the cards are full square scenes in the Lantern Cat look (full bleed, the photos show the card cut to 141 x 141 mm) and dogs get a real dog face.

postcard.style: Whimsical Nordic folk-art illustration in gouache with a dry-brush texture and a fine printed grain, like a Scandinavian winter storybook. Simple, soft, rounded animal shapes with big round shiny eyes, round rosy cheeks and a tiny smile. Cats have a small pink heart-shaped nose and long fine whiskers; dogs have a real dog face: a soft rounded muzzle, a round dark dog nose, dog ears and no long whiskers. Fine hand-painted folk patterns on every scarf, hat and sweater (zigzags, tiny snowflakes, dots, little hearts and stripes) and soft brush strokes in the fur. Around the animals, intricate folk botanical ornaments: fir and fern sprigs, berry sprays, small tulip-like folk flowers, leafy branches, snowflakes and little stars, painted with fine white, gold and red detail. Winter palette: deep night blue, berry red, coral, fir green, mustard gold, dusty pink, cream and soft charcoal.

plant-blue.title: Blue Fern
plant-blue.subject: one tall fern frond curving gently upward, with two small leaves at its base, with a few small, straight, upright plants (thin stems with tiny leaves, grass blades and small buds) growing from the same base as the main plant, beside it on both sides and lower than it, in the same Scandinavian mid-century folk art style, in the same single colour with the same gouache, dry-brush and coloured pencil texture
plant-blue.style: A minimal flat 2D illustration of plants only: no animals, no birds, no insects, no people, no objects. Art style and technique: Scandinavian mid-century folk art style. Gouache painting texture, dry-brush acrylic strokes, and visible colored pencil grain. Printed in ONE colour only: dark blue (deep navy blue). Every shape and line is that single colour, with its dry-brush and pencil texture showing; no second colour, no grey, no shading, no gradient. Simple, calm and minimalist: a few clear shapes and a lot of empty space. Folk details inside the leaves and petals (simple veins, dots, small dashes) in the same colour. Lines are drawn freehand with a brush: bold, a little uneven in width, gently curved, never thin or hairline, nothing drawn with a ruler. Strictly avoid: soft vector clipart, 3D shading, smooth gradients, digital softness, glossy textures, more than one colour.
plant-blue.edit: Keep the main plant exactly as it is. Add a few small, straight, upright plants (thin stems with tiny leaves, grass blades and small buds) growing from the same base as the main plant, beside it on both sides and lower than it, in the same Scandinavian mid-century folk art style, in the same single colour with the same gouache, dry-brush and coloured pencil texture. Keep plenty of empty white space around the drawing.

mug.label: Mug
mug.place: The artwork is centred on the front of the mug and wraps naturally around the curved surface, printed on the white glaze.
mug.note: Mug is white ceramic, 11 oz, only (John, 12 Oct 2026).

table.scene: High-end studio product photograph of a white glossy ceramic 11 oz coffee mug, handle on the right, the front of the mug facing the camera, standing on a light oak table, a small pumpkin and two autumn leaves beside it, soft window light from the left, warm neutral background softly out of focus, realistic ceramic reflections and a soft shadow.

home.scene: Lifestyle photograph in a calm, warm Scandinavian living room in autumn: the white ceramic mug stands on a wooden side table next to a sofa with a knitted blanket and a closed picture book with a plain cover and no words on it, steam rising from hot cocoa, soft evening lamp light, the front of the mug facing the camera, background softly out of focus.

mug.style: Cute illustration in the look of hand embroidery on white linen: every shape is made of fine satin-stitch thread with visible thread direction, French-knot eyes with a tiny white highlight, running-stitch whiskers and leaves. Warm Halloween colours: pumpkin orange, cream, soft black, sage green and mustard.
mug.layout: One small scene in the middle on {background}, with a lot of empty white space around it and a few tiny stitched stars. Only the flat picture itself, as a print file: do not draw the mug it will be printed on, no hoop, no product, no shadow.

tote.label: Tote bag, undyed
tote.place: Print only the drawing of the artwork, without its light background, directly on the natural canvas, centred on the front panel, about two thirds of the panel width, so the canvas weave shows through. Keep the drawing's own colours. It is a flat print on the canvas: the patches and stitches are printed, not sewn on.

table.scene: Top-down studio photograph of a natural unbleached organic cotton canvas tote bag lying flat on a light oak table, straps folded neatly above it, visible canvas weave and stitching, soft daylight, a few autumn leaves at the edge.

home.scene: Lifestyle photograph of the natural unbleached cotton canvas tote bag hanging from a wooden peg in a bright Scandinavian hallway in autumn, a closed picture book with a plain cover and no words on it peeking out of the bag, soft daylight, the front panel facing the camera.

hand.scene: Lifestyle photograph of an adult's hand holding the natural unbleached cotton canvas tote bag by its straps on an autumn street with orange leaves, the front panel facing the camera, soft natural light, background softly out of focus. Only an adult's hand and forearm are visible: no face, no child.

tote.style: Cute flat illustration in a cut-fabric patchwork look: tall, simple geometric animal shapes like patches of denim, linen and felt, with drawn running stitches and blanket-stitch edges, big round button eyes with a stitched white ring, small stitched noses and whiskers. Halloween pieces are cut from the same cloth: felt pumpkins, ghosts, bats, moons and stars with stitched edges. Soft craft colours: denim blue, warm grey, pumpkin orange, mustard and cream. Everything is drawn flat; nothing is three-dimensional.
tote.layout: The animals stand stacked or side by side like the picture on a handmade bag, centred on {background} with an even margin.

postcard.label: Postcard
postcard.place: The attached artwork is the whole front of the postcard: it runs to all four edges of the card, with no white or cream border, margin or frame around it. The postcard is landscape, matte, with rounded corners.

table.scene: Top-down studio photograph of a single landscape postcard (wider than tall) with rounded corners, thick matte card, lying on a light oak desk next to a pencil and a dried autumn leaf, soft daylight and a soft shadow.

hand.scene: Close-up photograph of an adult's hand holding the landscape postcard (wider than tall) with rounded corners by its edge, the picture side facing the camera, warm soft light, background softly out of focus. Only an adult's hand and forearm are visible: no face, no child.

postcard.style: Cute vintage screen-print illustration: four flat ink colours with slight misprint overlap, grainy halftone texture, simple rounded animals with big round eyes and tiny smiles, each with its own stripes, spots or patches. Retro Halloween palette: pumpkin orange, mustard, teal, cream and soft black.
postcard.layout: A full scene, full of life, that fills the whole picture edge to edge on {background}, with small pumpkins, ghosts, bats and stars tucked between the animals; the ground (grass, leaves or a path) runs off the bottom and both sides. This is a full-bleed print file: the colour reaches all four edges, with no paper margin and no cream or white strip, line, border or frame along any edge. Only the flat picture itself: do not draw the postcard, no stack of cards, no product, no shadow.
postcard.art_background: a dusk sky in muted plum-grey and teal
postcard.print_note: Gelato A6 postcard 148 x 105 mm plus 4 mm bleed on every side; the art is made at 3:2 and cropped to this shape. Keep faces and key shapes at least 9 mm from the edge (bleed + 5 mm from the 8 mm round corners). Full bleed (15 Oct 2026): the art covers the whole card. The old 'cream paper background' made the model draw a cream paper margin (cats, dogs) or a small picture in the middle of empty cream (dog), which showed as a white frame on the photos; the script now cuts thin paper strips off, warns about wide ones, and the photos use the card after cutting (trim_mm).

greeting-card.place: The artwork covers the whole front cover of the square folded card, edge to edge, exactly square. The card has sharp square corners.

home.scene: Lifestyle photograph of the square greeting card standing slightly open on a wooden shelf in a warm living room in autumn, next to a small pumpkin and a candle, background softly out of focus.

hand.scene: Close-up photograph of an adult's hand holding the square folded greeting card, the front cover facing the camera, a plain white envelope in the other hand, soft warm light, background softly out of focus. Only an adult's hand and forearm are visible: no face, no child.

greeting-card.style: Cute linocut block-print illustration: bold carved shapes with visible knife texture and a little ink unevenness, printed in three colours, simple rounded animals with big round eyes, tiny smiles and rosy cheeks. Halloween palette: pumpkin orange, mustard and soft black on cream.
greeting-card.layout: Centred on {background}, with a round moon behind and small carved pumpkins, bats and stars around. The picture is exactly square.
greeting-card.note: Two styles (John, 14 Oct 2026): the one-animal cards are linocut (this style), the many-animal cards are mid-century gouache (set on the designs cats and dogs).
greeting-card.print_note: Gelato square folded card 141 x 141 mm (5.25 x 5.25 in in the US and Canada) plus 4 mm bleed. Square, John 14 Oct 2026.

gift_set.scene: Flat lay studio product photograph taken from high above at a slight angle. Arrange the four attached products beside each other with space between them, fully visible and not overlapping, each one exactly as it looks in its own attached photo: the mug standing upright with its side visible, the tote bag, the landscape postcard with rounded corners (wider than tall) and the square folded greeting card with a plain white envelope. On a soft oatmeal linen surface, with small orange and white pumpkins, pine cones, autumn leaves and warm fairy lights around the edges. Soft daylight, calm premium styling. No book. No added text, logo or print.
